source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: MessageHeader author and recipient lists reference MailBoxHeaderString. Its description permits either a bare address or an RFC 5322 mailbox string and points to parseMailboxString for extracting parts. Preserve that distinction in schema documentation and consumers; treating author as a plain email address loses valid display-name data.
title: Use a mailbox-header type name when a value may include a display name
